description:
'''Indorock''' is a musical genre which originated in the 1950s in the Netherlands, fusing Indonesian and Western music. The genre has roots in [[Kroncong]] (traditional Portuguese-Indonesian fusion music), and was performed by people of the [[Indo people|Indo]] community in the Netherlands, as the [[Dutch Empire]] controlled what is now [[Indonesia]] for over 300 years until the 1940s.

Indorock is one of the earliest forms of "Eurorock". Its influence on Dutch popular music was considerable. The term Indorock was used in 1981 to refer to the genre and period retrospectively.
